title: MiningFatiguePlus
description: This lightweight Fabric mod seamlessly integrates Mining Fatigue into Minecraft's brewing system, offering strategic new options for combat and defense. You can now brew Potions of Mining Fatigue and craft Tipped Arrows of Mining Fatigue. Crucially, the ad
body:
Mining Fatigue+ expands the vanilla effect system by introducing brewable versions of the Mining Fatigue status effect.

# The mod introduces the following items:
1. Splashable Mining Fatigue Potion
2. Drinkable Mining Fatigue Potion
3. Lingering Mining Fatigue Potion
4. Tipped Mining Fatigue Arrow [CAN NOT BE OBTAINED WITHOUT CREATIVE]
